resolutions.researcher_notes: Status=operating well supported. DMS Projects lists MGSE Phase 2 Package 3 (Eastern Region Pipeline) as 'Completed', with 150 km of 56" on Shedgum-Riyadh Gas Pipeline 3 + 40 km of 56" on Shedgum-Riyadh Gas 2 (matches this GEM row exactly). Lamar/LAIC Industrial (the E&P contractor) describes the same two lines (56", ~150 km EWPS#1->BGCS#3 for SRG-3; ~40 km BGCS#3->KM245.2 for SRG-2) and states 'Completed in 2018'. Blackridge also confirms MGS-2 EPC works completed and the network in service. Two independent, non-GEM sources agree the pipe is built/completed -> operating.

StartYear1=2021 is only partially supported and start-year sources CONFLICT. Blackridge states the overall MGS-2 EPC works 'were completed in 2021, increasing capacity from 8.4 to 12.5 bcf/d' -> supports a 2021 commissioning at the program level, cited here. HOWEVER the Lamar/LAIC page for this exact Package 3 (Eastern Region) says its Engineering & Procurement scope was 'Awarded in 2015, Completed in 2018', and DMS states the expansion aimed to 'provide 12.5 BSCFD of Gas by 2020'. So the individual-segment date evidence points to 2018-2020, while the network-wide completion is 2021. 2021 is defensible as the program in-service year but is not independently corroborated for this specific segment; flagging the 2018 (E&P) / 2020 (target) / 2021 (program) spread for reviewer.

SegmentCost=255,000,000 USD could NOT be corroborated by any accessible source, and available figures CONTRADICT it. Lamar/LAIC (the actual Package 3 contractor) gives Value = USD 118.53 million (but that is the Engineering & Procurement scope only, not full EPC). DMS Projects reports the estimated budget as 'over $372 million'. Neither equals $255M; the $255M appears to be a distinct (possibly EPC-line) figure whose original source (metenders / an earlier Lamar page) is dead and not recoverable. No verifiable source supports the stated $255M value -> UNRESOLVED, cost value flagged for reviewer (118.53M E&P vs 255M GEM vs >372M DMS estimate).
